page_title: TOR 2-0 LAZ | Torino v Lazio 01/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to Nuno Tavares (Lazio) for his blatant foul.

90+3' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
90+2' Sandro Kulenovic (Torino) has tested the patience of referee Rosario Abisso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' Torino take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' Booking. Adrien Tameze (Torino) receives a caution from the referee.
90+1' What an amazing save by Ivan Provedel! Nikola Vlasic (Torino) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but fails.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
89' Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar.
89' Lazio fail to score from a corner as Alberto Paleari (Torino) leaps to collect the ball.
89' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lazio.
87' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

87' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) latches onto a precise lofted pass into the penalty area and produces a header at goal, but his attempt under the bar fails to beat Alberto Paleari, who makes a sensational save.
86' There's an opportunity for Nuno Tavares (Lazio) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

86' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. Lazio win a corner.
85' Here is a change. Matteo Prati is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Adrien Tameze (Torino).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sandro Kulenovic (Torino) comes onto the pitch for Giovanni Simeone.
84' Adam Marusic (Lazio) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
80' It is time for a substitution. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is on for Mattia Zaccagni.
80' The game is interrupted now, Enzo Ebosse (Torino) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
79' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Rosario Abisso had an easy-decision to make.
79' He should have scored! Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
76' What a miskick by Danilo Cataldi (Lazio). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
76' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

75' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
73' The referee signals a substitution. Cesare Casadei (Torino) is brought on as a substitute for Duvan Zapata.
72' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to make a change. Niels Nkounkou (Torino) replaces Rafael Obrador.
69' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

68' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee blows his whistle, Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
68' Gvidas Gineitis goes off the pitch and Ivan Ilic (Torino) comes on.
67' The corner from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is hurriedly cleared.
66' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Torino.
65' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Luca Pellegrini is replaced by Nuno Tavares (Lazio).
65' The game has come to an end for Matteo Cancellieri. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
62' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:5.
59' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
57' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

55' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Alberto Paleari, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.

53' 2 - 0 Goal! Rafael Obrador hands Duvan Zapata (Torino) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
52' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
49' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' Maurizio Sarri decides to make a substitution. Reda Belahyane will be replaced by Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).
46' The substitution has been made. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) has replaced Petar Ratkov.
46' Referee Rosario Abisso blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is booked by the referee.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
42' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
37' What a great touch by Reda Belahyane (Lazio) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
36' The corner from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is intercepted by Ivan Provedel.
35' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Torino have a corner.
34' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
34' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
30' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 5:3.
26' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
24' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

24' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Ivan Provedel has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Torino are going to take it.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Giovanni Simeone (Torino) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
21' Duvan Zapata (Torino) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender.
20' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
17' The game is interrupted as Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is flagged offside.
13' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
11' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alberto Paleari is well positioned and punches the ball away.
8' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) works the corner short.
7' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
5' Matteo Prati (Torino) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the left post.
5' The corner kick from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
3' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lazio will kick the game off.
Rosario Abisso got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
